# Parse all notes: extract date from title and habit values from content
import re

habit_order = None
rows = []  # list of (date_str, dict_of_habits)

for note in all_notes_data:
    title = note['title']
    # Extract date: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    content = note['content']
    # Parse lines like "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            key = key.strip()
            val = val.strip().lower()

    content = note['content']

            val = val.strip().lower()
            if val in ('yes', 'no'):

    if habit_order is None:
